text: wat. what is LoaderIsoView and what is IsoAuthor
resolution: Explained to the user (non-coder) what LoaderIsoView vs IsoAuthor are: both are the same 3D iso build map to them — LoaderIsoView draws the world with the real game engine (the primary big map, shows placed pieces instantly), IsoAuthor is the older React-drawn twin shown as the corner preview; the editor swaps them. The root smell: each pane keeps its OWN copy of the drag-paint placement gate, so the req_1944 family-aware fix in IsoAuthor never reached the pane the user actually builds in. Fix: pointed LoaderIsoView.paintKindOf at GAME_BUILD.catalog.family too (950d8fa4e), so a cooked floor/wall grid/line drag-paints in the live pane exactly like a built-in; removed the IsoAuthor diagnostic. Flagged the duplicated gate across the two panes as worth unifying later. Hot-reloads in the user's dev.
